prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent RGBA looping character aura sprite sheet.
Image 1 is a layout/intensity reference ONLY: a compact glow behind the character's UPPER BACK AND SHOULDERS, short rays spreading around the head and torso. DO NOT copy the pixel-art characters, UI, ground or scenery. Render ONLY the aura with no character.
Create ONE luminous pearl-white aura animation sheet, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equally sized square cells on a 2:1 landscape canvas. Invisible cell boundaries, no grid, no text, no numbers, no icons. Each cell contains the SAME aura at the SAME CENTER and SAME approximate diameter, with at least 16% fully transparent padding on every side.
Style: high-quality hand-painted fantasy game VFX, radiating narrow soft white light spokes around an open translucent central area; short tapered energy wisps and delicate floating sparks. Thin rays concentrate around upper-back/shoulder level. Sympathetic to the sample's bright protective glow, but crisp painterly game quality rather than retro pixelation. No huge angel wings, no solid disc, no magic-ring letters, no flames, no smoke cloud, no environment, no solid background.
Eight ACTUALLY DISTINCT drawn consecutive frames in a gentle seamless pulse loop. Rays change organic shape and density between frames, sparks move and dissipate, core breathing subtly. Frame 8 transitions naturally back to frame 1. No violent flashes, no sudden blast. Keep every ray fully inside its own cell.
Color: nearly neutral luminous white and pearl highlights, very slight cool tint only, so game tinting can produce icy cyan, violet, gold and warm crimson variants. All brightness resides in drawn aura; rest of image genuinely transparent. No black/gray backdrop, no cast shadow.
Behind-character use: center should remain low-opacity/open so that a foreground character is completely readable. Aura edges are delicate and luminous, neither opaque fog nor thick geometric polygon.
usage: Shared limited rarity rear aura, per-character tint; does not replace approved SD
